name: Belt of Sure Footing
summary: A belt that keeps you upright on ice, slick stones, and rocking decks.
description: The buckle is carved with a single stylized gull. Ferrymen wear it, and so do mountain guides.

stats.effect: While you wear this belt, you can't be given the {ref:condition/prone} condition while on the ground by effects that would trip or slip you, and nonmagical difficult terrain from ice, mud, or loose stone doesn't cost you extra movement.
